notes: v267 — LOAD-COUNT-DEAD (owner, Mon Oct 26, 2026 10:30 MDT, mid-shift at the pit: "That gps load tracking is not working at all now!" — zero automatic counts all morning on an ACTIVE Aecon dispatch day, cycling at a same-place load/dump site since ~08:00; loads were already 0 at 08:48). The whole pipeline was audited as shipped (v261 autostart/miles rework, v263 dispatch gate, v265 convergence) and driven in a new harness (tools/load-count-dead-v267-test.js, 19/19) that runs the REAL js/geoloads.js glue through today's states. FOUR zero-forever code breaks proven and fixed, all in js/geoloads.js (the v263 gate itself is exonerated: App.armDayMiles arms LiveMiles only and never touches GeoLoads; autostartDispatchFor is not in the load path at all): (A) STALE CONFIGURATION — counting was configured once at session start; nothing re-ran configure() when the dispatch landed mid-session (Connect/message/tap/yard flip), and onFix's armed guard returned before the day roll, so a session started before today's dispatch existed sat disarmed all day while fixes flowed. Fix: the day roll now runs before the feed (a fix is counted by its own day's machines), plus a throttled world check (the store's dsp_active vs the configured dispatch — the same record the dashboard shows) re-runs configure() whenever disarmed or the active dispatch changed; startDay's same-key reattach runs the same check; ingestNativeCrumbs runs it before its guard so a drain can no longer ack away crumbs nobody folded. (C) INTRA ACCURACY STARVATION — today's best fit: the pattern learner's intra-site machine RESET its sub-cluster on any fix rougher than 30 m (or null accuracy); every other machine in the engine ignores bad fixes entirely. Under any realistic wobble (harness: every 4th fix at 45 m) a same-place sub-spot could NEVER confirm — zero all day while 'learning'. Rough fixes are now ignored for intra, never fatal; the distance rule still restarts a cluster on a good fix away from its centroid. (B) ONE-PIN SAME-PLACE BLINDNESS — a dispatch with a load pin only enters teach mode, whose dump candidate must sit >= 300 m away: a same-place tip never qualifies. Teach mode now also runs a shadow pattern learner seeded on the pin that may arm the counter with an INTRA-site pair only (never an outer pair, never a contest), only while the dump learner has no loaded leg outstanding; a shadow-proven pair restores across relaunches as the day's pair. (H) MIS-ANCHORED PATTERN DAY — the learner anchored on the day's first dwell; an en-route fuel/coffee stop became the 'load site', cycles could never close (they close only at the anchor), and intra stayed suppressed while a candidate existed. A candidate confirmed 3 times with no cycle ever closed is the day's real hub: a LEARNED anchor is reassigned to it (a seeded pin anchor never is); the v220 two-cycle proof is untouched. (R) PATTERN-RESTORE COUNT LOSS — a pattern day's counts did not survive a same-session relaunch: the restore began the counter fresh with base 0, the face read 0, and the next persist overwrote the day record's real count (harness S10: 3 -> 0). Restores now hand the counter its own day-record snapshot with base = record - snapshot, the armed branch's long-standing formula. HARNESS: load-count-dead-v267 19/19 (S1 distinct-sites baseline, S2 same-place clean, S3/S3b wobble, S4 dispatch lands mid-session, S5 one-pin same-place, S6 too-close pins, S7 en-route stop, S8 yesterday-keyed session roll, S9 no-session binding documented, S10/S11 relaunch survival, S12 crumb drain while disarmed). A/B baselines held EXACTLY: geofence-loads 58/58, geoloads-learning 32/32, geoloads-v140 38/0, batch-v220 36/0, movement-arm 76/0, dispatch-autostart 73/0, pullgate 31/0, ingest 217/0, edit-start-v265 28/0, cloudsync-v136 51/0, cloudsync-record-union 12/0, manifest suites at baseline; fix-batch-v222 55/1 and native-track 34/1 and manifest-toggles 47/49 identical pre/post (pre-existing); loads-gps-fix-v203 keeps its stale v203-era failure signature (pre-existing since the v220 proof change). STATE NOTE (not code): GeoLoads remains session-bound by design — with no running session on the phone there is no counting (the day watch arms miles only); if his phone converged to idle after this morning's web stop, ONE tap on START (then edit the start to 8:00 AM) re-arms counting from that moment. Today's already-driven cycles are NOT recoverable into the counter: no watcher was armed for them and, where crumbs exist, they were acked in the ordinary drain — nothing is fabricated.
